theme_and_archetype.rationale: Customers seeking handcrafted goods need an environment that feels tactile, warm, and authentic. Terracotta and earthy tones evoke physical craftsmanship, rural heritage, and trust.

background.texture_overlay: Use the provided paper_texture image with opacity-20 or mix-blend-multiply for a tactile feel.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Elegant storytelling typography.

body.usage: Readable modern sans-serif for forms and paragraphs.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Use generous spacing for elegant layouts.

cards.style: Soft organic cards with rounded corners.

buttons.primary: bg-[#BD5745] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#A64A3A] transition-colors font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F5F2EB] text-[#2C2420] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#E8E3DD] transition-colors font-medium
buttons.outline: border border-[#E8E3DD] text-[#2C2420] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:border-[#BD5745] hover:text-[#BD5745] transition-colors font-medium

inputs.style: Rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#E8E3DD] focus:border-[#BD5745] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#BD5745] px-4 py-3

badges.style: bg-[#F5F2EB] text-[#8B6B56] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1 rounded-full

pages.Landing Page: Hero section with artisan storytelling layout.
pages.Product Details Page: Large product images with artisan story.

testing_attributes.required: All buttons and forms must include data-testid attributes.
